language.title: language is a web
language.subtitle: PalWeb is the Web of Palestinian Arabic

community.title: we create. you learn.
community.subtitle: everything on PalWeb is made by others like you

dictionary.title: hypertext dictionary
dictionary.subtitle: Go where your curiosity takes you.
dictionary.description: Highly detailed entries are just the beginning: hear everything out loud; jump between synonyms & antonyms; browse Sentences to see Terms in their context — & more!

search-genie.title: find anything
search-genie.subtitle: Just call the Search Genie.
search-genie.description: Search in Arabic or English & narrow down your search with a variety of filters tailored for the Arabic root-pattern system. Pin things to find them easily later!

sound-booth.title: sound booth
sound-booth.subtitle: Let your voice shine through.
sound-booth.description: Breathe life into language by recording pronunciation samples of everything in your dialect — & represent the diversity of Palestinian Arabic.

build-decks.title: deck builder
build-decks.subtitle: Build your vocabulary, Deck by Deck.
build-decks.description: Say goodbye to the busy work of piecing together your own vocabulary sets & micro-managing flashcard applications. Use the Deck Master to build your own Decks in a flash, then study them with total flexibility to adjust how you view them with just one click. Browse the Library to see Decks others have made!

card-dealer.title: srs review
card-dealer.subtitle: Don’t study hard; study smart.
card-dealer.description: Raise your Mastery Level for the Terms in your Decks & across the whole Dictionary with the Card Dealer, which will schedule Terms for review based on how well you know them. PalWeb will know your weak points even better than you yourself.

study-decks.title: quiz & score
study-decks.subtitle: Test yourself before you wreck yourself.
study-decks.description: Drill your flashcard Decks with customizable Quizzes that will put your knowledge of Arabic vocabulary to the test. Save your Scores & see how your learning journey evolves over time!

academy.title: lessons & activities
academy.subtitle: Go from zero to hero.
academy.description: Go through the Lessons to discover new words, learn new skills & practice with dialog templates! Each Lesson has an Activity designed to integrate everything you learn.

together.title: everyone get in
together.subtitle: We’re bringing learners, educators & speakers together.
together.description: Whether you're just starting to learn Arabic or you're a native speaker interested in language preservation, PalWeb's suite of database-powered learning & documentation tools bring everyone together to celebrate Palestinian Arabic.

arabic.title: stairway to Arabic
arabic.description-1: {highlight} Standard Arabic is hard — even for native Arabic speakers! Learning Spoken Arabic first mirrors how native speakers acquire language — socially & contextually — & makes transitioning to Standard Arabic not only easier but more meaningful, as you’ll already have an intuitive feel for structure, sound, and flow.
arabic.description-1-highlight: If you really want to learn Arabic, start with Spoken Arabic.
arabic.description-2: Palestinian Arabic is a form of Levantine Arabic, one of the most widely understood dialect families in the Arab world, {highlight-1} in Palestine, Jordan, Lebanon, Syria & beyond. It's one of the more conservative dialects of Spoken Arabic, with strong similarities to Standard Arabic (up to 80% lexical overlap!), making it {highlight-2} for learners to build a solid foundation in Arabic vocabulary & grammar.
arabic.description-2-highlight-1: spoken by up to 40 million people
